payload.title: File:Eoaluavis life restoration.png
payload.description_html: Life restoration of the Early Cretaceous bird Eoalulavis. This life restoration is an updated version of one that I drew alongside with the holotype fossil, mostly inspired by orders and families of birds living and feeding near water, such as Alcedinidae, Cinclidae and (to a less degree) Charadriiformes. The version shown here are meant have a more Charadriiform-like appearance, after a discussion I had about the original at the WikiProject Dinosaurs Image Review page (January, 2022).
